name: Refactoring UI (Claude Code skill)
summary: Claude Code skill that applies Refactoring UI's spacing, type, color and shadow rules when styling or reviewing UI.
description: Installs the book's concrete decisions as a skill: fixed spacing, type, weight, radius and five-elevation shadow scales, hierarchy through weight and color, contrast minimums and a tokens.css file. Loaded as a personal skill or checked into a project repository for a team.
contains: fixed spacing, type, weight, radius and shadow scales
hierarchy through weight and color rather than font size
five shadow elevations and 9-shade grey and primary ramps
assets/tokens.css with contrast-verified tokens and a dark-mode block
install as a personal or project Claude Code skill
MIT for the repo; the book itself is not included
